name: Refine
description: Rewrite the selected text into natural English in your own style, or translate any selected text into Bahasa Indonesia, using Groq.

options.label: Groq API key
options.description: From console.groq.com. Stored in your Mac's keychain.

options.label: Never send these words
options.description: Comma-separated, e.g. client or project code names. They're replaced with placeholders before sending and put back after. Links, emails, keys, code, phone numbers and long IDs are always hidden.
